acceptanceCriteria: packages/server/src/routes/api.ts preserves row metadata in compatibility no-query mode (returning { messages } with row metadata and no paging keys).

In cursor mode, when truncateToolOutput shortens tool output, packages/server/src/routes/api.ts marks response-only metadata with truncated: true and output_state: 'truncated' without writing truncated metadata back to the database.
GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/nodes/{nodeId}/messages/{messageId} returns full stored message output unchanged.

packages/web/src/lib/api.ts exports getWorkflowNodeMessages(runId, nodeId, options) and getWorkflowNodeMessage(runId, nodeId, messageId, options), forwarding options.signal to fetch without putting signal in URLSearchParams.

packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/runs.ts exports getNodeMessages(runId, nodeId, options) and getNodeMessage(runId, nodeId, messageId, options), forwarding options.signal through requestJson.
Path parameters in detail lookup URLs are safely encoded with encodeURIComponent for slash- and space-containing IDs.

Server tests in packages/server/src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts and client tests in packages/web/src/lib/get-workflow-node-messages.test.ts and packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/runs.node-messages.test.ts pass.

userStories.title: Build the shared cursor-page state machine
userStories.description: As a run-detail architect, I want a pure reducer and driver for cursor-based node message paging, so that all surfaces handle deduplication, scope keys, high-watermark completion, and network retries uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/node-message-pages.ts exports nodeMessageScopeKey, createNodeMessageState, reduceNodeMessagePage, reduceNodeMessageFailure, and drainNodeMessages.
nodeMessageScopeKey formats scope keys incorporating runId, nodeId, and selection (including rowId for kind: 'node' unscoped fallback to isolate historical executions).

reduceNodeMessagePage deduplicates messages by seq using Map<number, NodeMessageRow>, sorts rows ascending by seq, updates afterSeq, and marks complete only when hasMore is false and afterSeq >= highWatermark.
reduceNodeMessagePage and reduceNodeMessageFailure discard pages and errors originating from obsolete scope keys.
reduceNodeMessageFailure retains already-loaded rows in state, records error string, and preserves complete: false for resume/retry.

drainNodeMessages loops with limit: 100, passes occurrenceId and attemptId from selection, passes AbortSignal, notifies onState on each step, and halts on completion or abort without converting AbortError to retry error.

Pure tests in packages/web/src/lib/node-message-pages.test.ts cover paging, sorting, watermark completion, obsolete scopes, retry retention, and abort handling, passing with bun test src/lib/node-message-pages.test.ts.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 3 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-08-align-agent-history-responsive-run-room.md:491-630). userStories.title: Project recorded rows into agent history
userStories.description: As a run-detail engineer, I want a pure projection from node message rows and workflow events into structured agent history items, so that UI renderers receive unified assistant text, tool cards, and lifecycle items.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/agent-history.ts exports AgentHistoryItem (discriminated union of 'assistant', 'tool', 'lifecycle'), buildAgentHistory(input: AgentHistoryInput), toolContext(input: unknown), and toolRuntime(events, nodeId, toolUseId).
Assistant text is projected in sequence order reusing projectTextTranscript without duplicating deltas or snapshot text.
Tool call and result rows are paired using projectToolTranscript; tool card seq is taken from call row; toolUseId is taken from tool payload id.
toolContext extracts allowlisted keys ('cmd', 'path', 'file_path', 'query', 'url') preserving full trimmed values without slicing.

Tool outcome is derived strictly as 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed' (from nonzero exit code, error, or failed state), or 'unknown'; canLoadFullOutput is true when metadata indicates truncated: true or output_state === 'truncated'.
durationMs is joined only when exactly one tool_completed event matches nodeId, data.tool_call_id, and has finite non-negative data.duration_ms; returns null if zero or multiple events match.
Lifecycle rows are emitted for status messages as secondary items.
Tests in packages/web/src/lib/agent-history.test.ts pass with bun test src/lib/agent-history.test.ts.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 4 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-08-align-agent-history-responsive-run-room.md:631-729). userStories.title: Model execution identity and header data
userStories.description: As a run-detail architect, I want execution selection precedence, header view models, and opener IDs modeled in pure functions, so that both Legacy and Console select and display exact executions deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.ts exports chooseExecutionForNode, buildExecutionHeader, runtimeForSelection, roomOpenerId, and askCardId.
chooseExecutionForNode resolves execution in order: valid lastExplicitRowId > awaiting row > running row > latest row by order; returns null for unknown node.

buildExecutionHeader derives ExecutionHeaderModel with nodeId, nodeLabel, executionLabel ('Iteration N', 'Attempt N', 'Execution unknown'), status, startedOffsetMs (from run started_at), durationMs (only if selected row has duration), provider/model (only from matching node_started event), and unknownScope boolean.
roomOpenerId encodes surface ('legacy' | 'console'), kind ('log' | 'graph'), and key with encodeURIComponent and stable prefix.
askCardId encodes tool_use_id with prefix run-ask-card-.
packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-log-rows.ts and packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/inspect/build-log-rows.ts derive startedOffsetMs and unknownScope on LogRow.

Tests in packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.test.ts, packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-log-rows.test.ts, and packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/inspect/build-log-rows.test.ts pass.

userStories.title: Model room visits, responsive mode, and scroll following
userStories.description: As a run-detail developer, I want pure visit state management, scroll follow reducers, and rem-aware container measurement, so that room open/close, deep-linking, follow mode, and single-pane responsiveness are robust.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.ts exports RoomVisitState, openRoom, closeRoom, applyRoomDeepLink, rememberRoomScroll, and resetRoomVisit.
closeRoom clears selection while preserving lastExplicitRowByNode and scrollTopByScope; resetRoomVisit returns fresh state for changed runId.
applyRoomDeepLink applies deep-link node once per query entry, ignores manual close while query persists, and reopens if query leaves and re-enters.

packages/web/src/lib/room-scroll-follow.ts exports createScrollFollow, onRoomScroll, and jumpToLatest: completed/failed rows initialize at top (scrollTop: 0), running/awaiting at bottom (follow: true), upward scroll > 24px from bottom disables follow, jumpToLatest reenables follow.

packages/web/src/lib/use-container-split-mode.ts exports useContainerSplitMode(ref, minRem = 60): 'split' | 'single' measuring container width against root font size (minRem * rootFontPx) using ResizeObserver.
Unit tests in packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.test.ts, packages/web/src/lib/room-scroll-follow.test.ts, and packages/web/src/lib/use-container-split-mode.test.tsx pass.
